title: Saudi Arabian Chicken Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic chicken curry dish inspired by the cuisine of Saudi Arabia. This recipe combines tender chicken with a rich and creamy curry sauce.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the onion, ginger, and garlic.
Cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in the coconut milk and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and simmer until cooked through, about 10-12 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
